actualAPI.consumerScope: Direct META APIs only. No capture/from_host/host-envelope binding/import/recorder or handwritten constraint execution.

primitives.blob: [byteLength] followed by each exact byte as one integer lane, including a length lane for empty payload.
primitives.text: blob of all canonicalUTF8 bytes of the complete source String; byte length, not character count.
primitives.opt_pair: None=[0]; Some=[1] then pair, even if both strings empty.
primitives.digest: Unselected=[0]; Selected=[1], then pair(format), then blob(bytes). Selected format/payload are opaque representation, not authenticated digests.
primitives.identity: profile_id as one u8 lane; grammar as one lane (DedicatedSorts0,GenericNominalExtensionReserved1); finance as one lane (Absent0,TypedExtensionReserved1); pair(layout_version); digest(layout_digest); digest(bounds_digest); opt_pair(field_id); digest(program_membership_digest), exact order.
primitives.boundsScalarWidths: First19 fields native usize; last3 max_reference_work/max_helper_work/step_cap rawu128. Do not narrow rawu128 to usize.
primitives.widths: None=[0]; Some=[1], then index_widths,counter_widths,record_widths in order; each list starts [entryCount], then every text(name) and nativeu32 width. Empty present lists retain all three count prefixes; duplicates/order kept.
primitives.run_int: Negative=[0,0]; Nat(n)=[1,n], including0 and rawu128MAX; NatAboveU128=[2,0]. Tags/padding distinguish it from any Nat. Direct metadata decoding returns these diagnostic variants; this is not their genesis/admission validity.

sourceCounters.blob_bytes: Starts0; every blob adds its raw payload byte length, text and selected-digest bytes together. Length prefixes are not counted.
sourceCounters.width_entries: Starts0; each of the three present width lists adds its full raw entry count; nothing from absent widths.
sourceCounters.cursor: Starts3 for reader after header. Every consumed scalar/count/payload advances over exactly that representation. Successful positive full decode consumes the entire stream with no trailing lanes. These are diagnostic representation counters, not B work/helper steps/fees.

usedByDirectMETA: max_string_bytes applies separately to every text/digest blob
max_metadata_bytes applies cumulatively to all text+selecteddigest payload bytes across admission/layout/run identity
max_width_entries applies cumulatively across all three layout width lists
callerLimits.distinction: The all-empty cases deliberately retain outer host/state limits0. This does not assert encode_host/decode_host or any state/whole-host call accepts that configuration. Do not add an outer host bound to the direct META counterpart.

positivePremises: All typed source Strings canonical validUTF8; all raw opaque byte elements0..255, profile0..255,width0..u32MAX, nativeusize fields fit selected64bit host, rawu128 fields0..2^128-1.

All blob payload lengths obey source max_string_bytes; cumulative text+digest bytes obey max_metadata_bytes; cumulative width entries obey max_width_entries, and all source checked arithmetic/size calculations fit. These are existing normal-success domain premises, not new model guards/refusal rules.
Only full canonical images of these typed inputs are decoded. No malformed/error-firstness/sourceauthentication or refusal validation is modeled or specified by this task.

Admission identity/run identity need not match for diagnostic metadata representation. Admission bounds/layout bounds likewise remain separate. Reserved grammar/finance/profile tags and RunInt negative/above variants do not establish an admitted program, valid genesis, authority or financial behavior.
independentAuthorNeed: Root assigns independent owner after this input/spec freeze. Derive complete encoded lanes, decoded completebyteprojection, blob span order/paths, both final counters and finalcursor only from SAFE input/bodyfree spec/declarations. No writer/reader/encoder/decoder/model/tests/review/actual/oldexpected body read. Original and typedtransport data remain independently frozen/private before later model implementation.
limits: No model implementation or expected output calculation in this batch stage.
Opaque digest encoding selects no cryptographic meaning or approval; no source runtime fees/helper clocks/cost decisions added.
All retained G/E/D/N and25refinementOPEN remain separate.
